answer_1.quote: We propose the task of meme captioning, in which models are presented with a meme along with its title ... and is tasked with generating a concise caption describing the meaning of the meme.
answer_1.outputs: Concise meme captions that convey the intended meaning of the meme.

answer_2.quote: We use standard metrics for automatic evaluation of generative tasks: BLEU (Papineni et al., 2002) ROUGE, and BERTScore (using microsoft/deberta-xlarge-mnli).

answer_4.quote: We randomly sampled 30 memes along with their model-generated and human-written captions. The annotation was performed by students in the lab, and we took the majority vote across 3 annotators.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated each generated caption according to several criteria.
